verdict.rationale: Prompt/prefix caching and its pricing is a fair question for an LLM model family that can be served through an API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a caching feature, cached-token pricing, or latency savings for repeated context. Partner hosting and local runtimes such as llama.cpp are host-platform or adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can cut cost and latency on repeated context with documented prompt/prefix caching and its pricing
